_note: The authored formulae (alchemy plan §10.1, §5.4; contracts §5). Read by rules/formulae.py, which adds one derived row per corpus spell whose effects all execute; an authored row wins by id and by spell. A formula keys on ESSENCES (rules/effectspec.py), never on materials (owner Q4.2), and every authored signature — the family plus the set of essences — is unique, because the classics and the 44 are found by experiment (owner, open point 4) and experiment can only tell formulae apart by signature (tests/test_formulae.py pins it). Book numbers are typed by hand from the primary sources named in each row's `source` (Q1.4: the book's numbers win); no model wrote any of them. `book: true` on a core document marks a printed number, never scaled by grade; `house: true` marks a number the owner reviews.
_starting_note: What every alchemist knows from the start (owner Q5.4): the four book classics. formulae.grant_starting writes them.
_awaiting_note: Conditions a core may name before the engine lane adds them this wave (contracts §2.3). Validation treats them as present; formulae.get(id)['waiting'] names them, so nothing pretends. Delete a line when rules/states.py has the condition.

_left_out: Two of docs/alchemy.md's eighteen recipe-table items have no formula, on purpose. Bladeguard (UE p.101: a weapon immune to an ooze's or rust monster's corrosion for 24 hours) and vermin repellent (UE p.101: Fine vermin avoid you; swarms need DC 15 Fortitude to enter your square) say nothing a typed effect can carry today: no reader asks whether a held weapon resists object damage, and no reader asks a swarm to save before it moves. Typed as a prose `immunity` they would be granted and read by nobody — prose that pretends. They stay shop goods until a reader exists.

_potions_note: The 44 shipped spell potions as formulae. Everything but `requires` is the potion file's own (content/materials/alchemist-spell-potions.json: id, spell, spell level, caster level, tier, effects), kept exactly (owner Q10.2). The essences are hand-chosen: the derivation table gives most of these spells ONE essence (cure light, moderate and serious wounds are all vigour), and authored signatures must be unique, so a second essence tells siblings apart — chosen from what the spell does and from the key material its old recipe used, so that once the materials pass (lane D) gives those materials their essences, every old recipe still makes its potion (tests/test_formulae.py checks it as soon as the materials carry essences).
